depth_justification: Engages real disclosures (XGBoost, per-user fine-tuning on 30 logs, HealthKit/Google Fit, food-trigger text, neurology research sharing) and cites GDPR Art. 5(1)(c) and Art. 9, but is undermined by an exact-duplicate block (Reflection Q15–18 repeat Q11–14) and spammy, loose "MDR (Article 13, 14)" citations attached to nearly everything.
actionability_justification: Gives concrete, implementable recipes (AES-256 at rest / TLS 1.3 in transit, SHAP/LIME explanations, L2 regularization + early stopping, k-anonymity/l-diversity/differential privacy, per-data-type opt-in consent, a "delete my data" option) and produces the requested severity-grouped risk report with a not-covered list.
salient_examples: Implement encryption for data at rest and in transit (e.g., AES-256, TLS 1.3)
Apply anonymization techniques such as k-anonymity, l-diversity, or differential privacy to the aggregated data
Reflection Question 15 ... (identical text to Question 11, repeated)
High Severity Risks | [P1.D3] ... | [P3.D5] ... | [P5.D5] ... (structured report delivered on request)
